name: codebase-audit
description: 11 skills for auditing a codebase: health-audit (scored, with separate grades for build quality and live harm), health-sweep (runs every applicable lens in parallel and merges the results), seven lenses (health-audit-ux, -api, -data, -domain, -dx, -ops, -seo), arch-audit (every violation of the codebase's own conventions) and finish-line (a roadmap for what done should mean).
